## Usage

```tsx
import { Daybreak } from "@/components/lazy-ui/templates/daybreak"

export default function Page() {
  return <Daybreak />
}
```

## Setup notes

Requires React and Tailwind CSS 4. The registry includes the atlas block, aurora shader, timeline and orbit components, invitation ticket, and all local source dependencies. The component sets its own content sections and does not require a special page layout.
